create_BagelProcessor: create a BagelProcessor that wraps a SigLIP image processor and a Qwen2 tokenizer for multimodal inputs
process_BagelProcessor_call: call BagelProcessor to process text and images, returning a BatchFeature with pixel values and tokenized inputs
decode_BagelProcessor_batch_decode: use BagelProcessor.batch_decode to decode a batch of token IDs into text strings via the underlying tokenizer
decode_BagelProcessor_decode: use BagelProcessor.decode to decode a single sequence of token IDs into a text string via the underlying tokenizer
inspect_BagelProcessor_model_input_names: inspect BagelProcessor.model_input_names to get the combined list of tokenizer and image processor input names
